main_text.p: ὑπήκοος ὁ ἡ (ἀνωμάλως pro ὑπήκοος. augmen-tum enim usitatè in ortis abjicitur) obe-diens. ab ὑπακούω obedio.

ὑπηρέτης ὁ proprie remex. per syn. spec. quilibet minister, famulus. ἐξ ἐχθρῶν sic appellantur Ecclesiarum pastores (ex ὑπὸ ἐρέτης ὁ remex, qui remum in navi agit. Th. ἐρέσσω vel ῥάω rémigo. Fut. ἐρέσσω. P. ἤρεσμαι. prat.pass. ἠρέσθην.
ὑπηρετέω ὦ servio, ministro cum Dat. Fut. ὑπηρετήσω. a.1. ὑπηρέτησα. P. ὑπηρέτημαι. ὑπηρεσία, ας ἡ ministerium.
ὕπνος ὁ somnus. item securitas carnalis, Rom.13.11.
ὑπό praepos. cum Genit. a, ab. sequitur verba passiva, Luc.4.15. Rom.12.21. cum Dat. sub. cum Accus. sub 1.Cor.10.1. subter Joh.1.49. in potestate Matth.8.9. Gal.4.2.
ὑποβάλλω subjicio seu suborno. Fut. ὑποβαλῶ. P. ὑποβέβλημαι. a.2. act. ὑπέβαλον ἐς ἐ.
ὑποδείκνυμι praemonstro, indico. Fut. ὑποδείξω. aor.1. ὑπέδειξα. P. ὑποδέδειγμαι. prat.pass. ὑποδεδειγμαι, unde ortum est
ὑποδέχομαι excipio. Fut. ὑποδέξομαι. prat.pass. ὑποδέδεγμαι excépi. aor.1.med. ὑποδεξάμην ω ἀξ idem.
ὑποδέω súbligo, unde accipitur pro calceo. calceare
Marginal notes on right page are cropped and largely illegible.

page.notes: Right margin notes (Latin, e.g. "calceum induo", "subjugis", "imitator") are cut off at the edge and too damaged to read reliably; omitted. Greek transcription is approximate in places; accents and breathings are uncertain. Page header Υ π is a partial running head.
